sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: Study both examples. The second one drops some of the wording of the first.

items.prompt: Relationship A: x: 0, 1, 2, 3 y: 1, 3, 5, 7. Relationship B: x: 0, 1, 2, 3 y: 7, 6, 5, 4. At which x-value do the two relationships have the same y-value?

steps: Compare the y-values in each table row by row.
At x = 2, Relationship A gives 5 and Relationship B also gives 5.
No other row has matching y-values, so x = 2 is the answer.

items.prompt: Solve the system: y = x + 4 and y = -x + 2. In which quadrant does the intersection lie?

steps: Substitute to get y = -1 + 4 = 3, so the point is (-1, 3).
Since x is negative and y is positive, the point lies in Quadrant II.

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Work these with your teaching parent. Say the reason for each step out loud before you write it.

items.prompt:
Solve the system:
y = -x + 5
4x + 2y = 12
Use substitution to find the solution (x, y).

Solve the system:
x - 4y = 2
x + y = 2
Use elimination to find the solution (x, y).
Classify the system: y = -5x and y = -5x - 14. Does it have one solution, no solution, or infinitely many solutions?

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: The reference equation is y = -2x - 4. Which of these equations, paired with the reference, would give the system infinitely many solutions?
Plan A charges a $15 flat fee plus $7 per month. Plan B charges a $39 flat fee plus $4 per month. After how many months do the two plans cost the same, and what is that cost?
Plan A charges a $37 flat fee plus $9 per month. Plan B charges a $42 flat fee plus $4 per month. The solution to the system is (1, 46). What does this solution represent?
choices: Plan A costs $46 more than Plan B after 1 month.

items.prompt: System: y = 2x + 20 and y = 8x + 50. Does the point (-4, 13) satisfy both equations, fail one, or fail both?

sections.title: Mastery check
sections.directions: Mastery check. Work without help, then stop and hand this section in.

items.prompt: Plan A charges a $56 flat fee plus $5 per month. Plan B charges a $104 flat fee plus $1 per month. The solution to the system is (12, 116). What does the y-coordinate of the solution represent?
choices: The difference in cost between the two plans.
The shared cost, in dollars, when the two plans are equal.
The rate Plan B charges per month.
The number of months after which the two plans cost the same.
